Package eu.algites.lib.action.execution.transaction.journal

Interface AIiTransactionJournal<X extends Exception>

Type Parameters:
X - domain-specific append validation exception
All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournal<AIiTransactionJournalEntry,X>, eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiReadOnlyJournal<AIiTransactionJournalEntry>
public interface AIiTransactionJournal<X extends Exception> extends eu.algites.lib.journal.AIiJournal<AIiTransactionJournalEntry,X>
Specialized durable append-only transaction journal with one logical stream per top-level transaction. A child subtransaction uses its root journal; external independent transactions have separate journals. The same generic before/after append semantics apply; an in-memory implementation alone is not crash-durable.
